scope: Snapshot-based retained-career planning; not an earned count or completion percentage

early_promotion_route_audit.constraint: Reviewed rites do not return this existing character to unpromoted x0/100 or Taoist101; selecting a promoted class does not earn its trainer receipt.
early_promotion_route_audit.legacy_helpers: Direct class setters/legacy constructors do not establish an ordinary earning route; bounded caller inspection found no alternative ordinary route for the retained profile.
early_promotion_route_audit.fresh_character_distinction: Creation can select an unpromoted school on a new identity; that is not recovery of the retained character's missing receipts.

limitations: Excluding an unproven promotion route is a planning assumption, not proof it is impossible.
Candidate identities may still have incompatible prerequisites; this is not a playable upper/lower bound.
Present receipts include supplied and observed state; they are not all independently earned.
Private opt-in receipts do not override default activation or native/deployment gates.
Receipt absence does not by itself identify an implementation defect.
